newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian shares dragged lower by Richter.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian shares dragged lower by Richter.

text.p: Hungarian shares were largely firm on Friday but a sharp fall at drug firm Richter dragged the index lower.
* Hungary's BUX share index finished at 6,290.35 points, down 14.70 or 0.23 percent.
* Seventeen of the 36 shares which traded on Friday firmed, eight declined and 11 was flat.
* Drug maker Richter fell 3.5 percent following news that a U.S. company filed a lawsuit against it for breach of contract.
